description: This file defines the MatchCenterScreen widget, a stateful screen in a Flutter app that displays cricket match fixtures and results with filtering capability. It manages UI components such as app bar, section headers, filter pills, and match cards, and interacts with data and notification services.

classes.name: MatchCenterScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget serving as the main screen for displaying cricket match fixtures and results with filtering options.

classes.name: _MatchCenterScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the dynamic content of MatchCenterScreen, including active tab index, and building the UI with filtered match lists.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the MatchCenterScreen widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the MatchCenterScreen, including app bar, filters, and match list.
